fact: On 26 May 2026 the state-owned Société d'Infrastructures Numériques, which operates the Lomé Data Centre, signed a private-cloud partnership with ST DIGITAL; the centre is described as Tier III certified (Uptime Institute) with 99.982% availability.
title: Togo : la SIN et ST DIGITAL s’allient pour une offre de services de cloud privé au Lomé Data Centre
